source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: At the accepted revision, createServer records the new key and pushes a server into the service before protocol-specific configuration runs. CreateInBackend catches a configureOutgoingServer failure, deletes that server and rethrows. Keep the rollback aligned with the operation that mutates the service list. This is newer accepted context for the 2024 server-creation change, not an addition made by entry 903. Account-level rollback and failure injection were not verified.
title: Roll back an outgoing server added before asynchronous configuration fails
